# Greetro

> Greetro is an AI voice receptionist for small businesses. It answers every call within two rings, 24/7/365, in 30+ languages, sounding like a calm human receptionist. It books appointments with two-way Google and Outlook calendar sync, answers questions from a business-specific knowledge base, takes structured messages, sends SMS follow-up links, transfers genuinely urgent calls to a human on-call number, and logs every call with a full transcript and a two-line AI summary. It works with a business's existing phone number via call forwarding — no new hardware or phone system.

Planned pricing at launch (USD, monthly). Greetro is pre-launch: there is no signup, no checkout and no free trial, and these prices are not yet final:
- Starter — $49/mo: 1 business number, 250 call minutes, 24/7 answering, appointment booking, transcripts and AI summaries.
- Pro — $149/mo: 3 business numbers, 1,000 call minutes, Google and Outlook calendar sync, 30+ languages, SMS follow-ups.
- Scale — $399/mo: 10 business numbers, 4,000 call minutes, CRM integrations and API, priority support.

Typical customers: dental and medical clinics, law firms, salons and spas, trades and contractors, real-estate offices, agencies and studios — any business where a missed call is a missed customer.

## Status

Greetro has not launched. There is no product to sign up for, no account system, no checkout and no free trial. The website's only function is a waitlist form (name, work email, business type). Prices shown are planned launch pricing and may change.
